about.description:
Computes alpha and beta diversity metrics using concurrent 'C' threads.
Metrics include 'UniFrac', Faith's phylogenetic diversity, Bray-Curtis
dissimilarity, Shannon diversity index, and many others.

If you use this package in your research, please cite the official JOSS paper:
Smith et al., (2026) <doi:10.21105/joss.09777>.
about.summary: Parallel and Memory-Efficient Ecological Diversity Metrics

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2.2.6" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-ecodive
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/ecodive_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/ecodive/ecodive_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6679b523c3b63cce48de0d918eb1f0ba663b27df1578bee730462691615771da

build:
  number: 1
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}            # [not win]
    - {{ compiler('c') }}          # [not win]
    - {{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}      # [win]
    - {{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}    # [win]
    - {{ posix }}filesystem        # [win]
    - {{ posix }}make
    - {{ posix }}sed               # [win]
    - {{ posix }}coreutils         # [win]
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
  run:
    - r-base

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('ecodive')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('ecodive')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://cmmr.github.io/ecodive
  dev_url: https://github.com/cmmr/ecodive
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT'
    - LICENSE
  summary: Parallel and Memory-Efficient Ecological Diversity Metrics
  description: |
    Computes alpha and beta diversity metrics using concurrent 'C' threads.
    Metrics include 'UniFrac', Faith's phylogenetic diversity, Bray-Curtis
    dissimilarity, Shannon diversity index, and many others.
    
    If you use this package in your research, please cite the official JOSS paper:
    Smith et al., (2026) <doi:10.21105/joss.09777>.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - dansmith01
